note: All times are estimates (narration ~2.3 words/s, typed dialogue ~2.8 words/s, plus pauses). Re-lock to the Ch 1 voiceover when it arrives. Coordinates are Blender metres in scenes/03-ivan-room (x east, y north, z up; desk wall y=4.8, window wall x=0); void shots use the void stage's own frame (Ivan at the origin).

light_states.3am: existing room03 bake (lamp, screens, moon, city)
light_states.4am: 3am bake with live changes: lamp x0.6, screens x1.3, city windows -40%, exposure -0.3 EV, haze +
light_states.4am_iso: 4am with lightmap groups ROOM/WALLN/CEIL/ARCH at x0.12, DESK group full: the desk in a pool of light
light_states.day: new bake: warm afternoon (two days earlier), sun soft through the window, screens weak, lamp off
light_states.dusk: new bake 'evening': blue dusk, city lights coming on
light_states.evening: same bake as dusk, a little later; lamp on
light_states.sunrise: new bake: low sun straight through the window, mullion shadows across the bed, floor and Ivan
light_states.void: separate black stage: no room, light only from streak and bokeh emitters

beats.name: 3 AM
beats.script: Para 1-3: "It's 3 AM..." to "Ivan keeps saying yes."
beats.purpose: Hook and setup: Ivan alone at the one lit desk, the untouched glass, the system growing. Then the joke that is the thesis: Claude builds, Ivan says yes.
beats.feeling: cold, compelled; a dry laugh on "Well..."
beats.sound: room tone, laptop fan, hard fast typing; sparse synth pulse; a held breath of silence before "Well..."; three dry key taps on "yes"

beats.name: Two days ago
beats.script: Para 4-8: "It started two days ago." to "Review and approve."
beats.purpose: Flashback: how it began. Overwhelmed, offered relief, said yes. The promise: review and approve.
beats.feeling: frazzled, then relief and a little delight
beats.sound: daytime city through the glass, phone typing taps; the Claude sprite's chime (tuned to the motif); first warm statement of the motif

beats.name: Cheat code
beats.script: Para 9-10 (first half): "But once the email system was working..." to "...now takes minutes."
beats.purpose: Escalation: one module becomes five, days blur, life gets easier. Re-hook every 3-5 s (cards, eyes, icons, time-lapse, list, smile, clock).
beats.sound: each module pop is one note of the motif; time-lapse = room tone pitched and sped up, no stock whoosh; clock ticks accelerate then stop dead

beats.name: Another frequency
beats.script: Para 10 (second half): "Ivan feels like he's vibrating..." to "...others can't even see."
beats.purpose: The turn: the one style switch of the chapter. The room falls away into an abstract void of light; he alone vibrates; a door of light opens. Peak of the high.
beats.sound: room sound cut to nothing on the first frame of the void; music swells to its fullest; a single high tone at the door; silence on the white frame

beats.name: Barely slept
beats.script: Para 11-12: "He's barely slept." to "Then he'll rest." (+ the phone on the couch)
beats.purpose: The cost. Back to the real room: the girlfriend's unanswered text against his system answering everyone; he knows; he keeps going.
beats.sound: phone buzz muffled by the duvet; a run of soft 'sent' ticks from the desk; a thin high whine under "thinness"; the empty bed in near silence

beats.name: 4 AM
beats.script: Para 13: "It's not all pleasant." to "The machine does what HE told it to do."
beats.purpose: Crisis and release: dread in the dark, then the module works and the dread turns into a rush and pride.
beats.light: 4am, 4am_iso, then a green-warm spill from the screens
beats.sound: low pulse like a heartbeat; mug rattle; the Enter key hit (transient, body, tail); a tests-pass chord; the motif lands loud on "HE built that"

beats.name: Sunrise
beats.script: Para 14-15: [Dawn at the window.] "By sunrise..." to "...supposed to do now."
beats.purpose: Return with a change, and the button. Everything is done; he turns his back on the screens to the sun, and has nothing left to do.
beats.sound: first birds and traffic; the motif once, slow, on a soft piano; then only room tone through the final hold

vo.text: It's 3 AM and Ivan hasn't eaten since lunch.
There's a glass of water on his desk that he poured six hours ago.
It's still full.
He's hunched over his laptop, typing furiously, eyes bloodshot.
A terminal window, a Claude chat, and a growing sprawl of Python scripts.
He's building an email automation system.
Well...
Technically, Claude is doing the building.
Ivan keeps saying yes.
It started two days ago.
i have like 400 unread emails. every single one wants a reply.
i'm fucking drowning here!
That sounds genuinely exhausting - and you're definitely not alone!
I can write a script that sorts your inbox and drafts the replies for you.
You just review and approve. Want me to build one?
That was the plan.
Review and approve.
But once the email system was working,
Ivan saw what else was possible.
Calendar management. Meeting scheduling. Document drafting. Research summaries.
Each one a few hours of coding.
Each one removing another task from his daily routine.
It's like discovering a cheat code for life.
Every problem that used to take hours now takes minutes.
Ivan feels like he's vibrating at a different frequency
than everyone around him,
like he's stepped through a door that others can't even see.
He's barely slept.
His girlfriend stopped texting because he wasn't responding.
Ironic, given that his system now responds to everyone else.
He knows this isn't healthy.
He can feel something fraying at the edges of his mind, a thinness to his thoughts.
But he's close to something.
One more module. One more integration.
Then he'll rest.
It's not all pleasant.
Around 4 AM, when his eyes burn
and his hands shake from a caffeine overload,
Ivan feels a creeping dread.
A sense that he's building something he doesn't fully understand.
That each automation takes something from him, even as it gives something back.
But then he finishes another module,
and it works,
and the dread dissolves into a rush of pure satisfaction.
HE... built that.
The machine does what HE told it to do.
By sunrise, Ivan has a system
that handles his email, manages his calendar, drafts his documents, and summarizes his reading.
He leans back in his chair, exhausted and wired.
Then he realizes...
he doesn't know what he's supposed to do now.

shots.name: Three AM
shots.script: (pre-VO opening, no line)
shots.framing: top-down wide, ceiling pulled
shots.focus_plan: fixed on the room floor plane, deep stop
shots.action: Ivan hunched at the desk, typing (intro performance).
shots.why: Straight down into his room: bed, guitar, rugs, the lamp, and at the edge of it all the one lit desk. He is small inside his world. Lens raised from 17 to 18 mm to keep inside the 18-100 mm rule.

shots.script: (pre-VO opening, no line)
shots.framing: insert, phone on the duvet
shots.move: creep in 3 cm with a slow zoom (as E2)
shots.action: none in frame (Ivan typing off-screen; keyboard sound only)
shots.screen: phone lock screen: 3:04, three unanswered texts from Sarah, Mail: 214 new
shots.props: phone moved from the desk to the bed (north-east corner of the duvet)
shots.why: E2 re-staged on the bed: the phone lies three metres from him, face up and ignored. It is planted where it lights up again in D02.

shots.name: The zone
shots.script: "It's 3 AM and Ivan hasn't eaten since lunch."
shots.framing: wide, from the dark door corner
shots.move: one long slow push across the room
shots.action: typing, hunched (intro performance)
shots.why: One long slow push toward the only lit corner, where he works.

shots.name: Still full
shots.script: "There's a glass of water on his desk... It's still full."
shots.framing: desk height, glass foreground, Ivan behind
shots.focus_plan: glass -> Ivan typing -> glass on "still full"
shots.action: typing
shots.why: The chapter's one image: the untouched glass in front of the glowing screens.

shots.name: Bloodshot
shots.script: "He's hunched over his laptop, typing furiously, eyes bloodshot."
shots.framing: CU face, dolly zoom
shots.move: dolly zoom: camera pulls back as the lens closes in
shots.action: hunches deeper, typing hard
shots.why: His face holds still while the room crowds in behind him.

shots.name: Reading
shots.script: "A terminal window, a Claude chat, and a growing sprawl of Python scripts."
shots.framing: over the left shoulder, close on the laptop
shots.move: tiny push; aim keyed along the screen (intro atKeys)
shots.focus: READ (intro keyed pulls, line by line)
shots.focus_plan: focus moves line by line like his eyes
shots.action: typing, reading
shots.screen: terminal, Claude chat streaming, file list (intro screens)
shots.why: The screen read like his eyes read it. Caption text changes: the script dropped "On the screen:".

shots.name: The pipeline
shots.script: "He's building an email automation system." + "Well..."
shots.framing: behind him, head soft foreground, pipeline monitor
shots.action: typing
shots.screen: pipeline: inbox, classify, draft, review, send
shots.props: optional: hand-drawn label "EMAIL AUTOMATION SYSTEM" with a pointer, as drawn on the board
shots.why: The thing he is building, named. The board adds a hand-lettered callout; see open questions.

shots.name: Claude builds
shots.script: "Technically, Claude is doing the building."
shots.framing: 3/4 side MS from his left front, laptop at frame left
shots.focus_plan: on his eyes; the full glass soft in the low foreground
shots.action: Ivan sits back 5 cm from the keyboard, hands lift off the keys and rest on the desk edge; he watches, eyes tracking the text; one small nod.
shots.screen: laptop: Claude chat streams 'Writing classify.py... done. Writing draft_reply.py...'; the editor fills with code by itself
shots.why: His hands are off the keyboard: the code writes itself. The first time we see who is really building.

shots.name: Saying yes
shots.script: "Ivan keeps saying yes."
shots.framing: macro, keyboard from the right, screen soft above
shots.action: Right index finger: Y, then Enter, three times, each faster (keys hit at 34.6, 35.4, 35.9 s).
shots.screen: soft at frame top: 'Apply 3 changes? (y/n)' -> y -> 'Add tests? (y/n)' -> y -> 'Deploy? (y/n)' -> y
shots.why: The joke of the chapter as an action: three yeses, faster each time.

shots.name: Two days ago
shots.script: "It started two days ago."
shots.framing: locked wide from the door wall: window left, desk right
shots.action: Ivan stays hunched; the light runs backwards around him.
shots.props: dressing swap during the blend: mugs, wrappers and the poured glass fade out; one fresh mug in
shots.why: Time told by light alone: the night drains out of the same room and it is two days earlier.

shots.name: Drowning
shots.script: IVAN: "i have like 400 unread emails. every single one wants a reply."
shots.framing: MS, low, from the desk end; window blown out behind him
shots.focus_plan: on his eyes; the chat card soft at frame right
shots.action: Reclined far back in the desk chair, one sock foot on the desk-pedestal edge, phone held up in the right hand, thumb-typing; mouth moves (muttering), eyebrows up in exasperation.
shots.screen: floating chat card (frame right, upper third, at ~[0.75, 3.90, 1.30]): his message types out letter by letter
shots.props: phone in hand; floating chat card
shots.why: The board's frame: warm afternoon, Ivan sprawled, the chat floating beside him. He is a normal guy having a bad inbox day.

shots.name: Send
shots.script: IVAN: "i'm fucking drowning here!"
shots.framing: insert over his left shoulder onto the phone
shots.action: Thumb types the line, jabs Send at 47.6 s.
shots.screen: phone: Mail badge 412 unread at the top; Claude chat, his message, Send
shots.why: The macro insert on hands and phone (fern's device) gives the line a physical action.

shots.name: Hello, Claude
shots.script: CLAUDE: "That sounds genuinely exhausting - and you're definitely not alone!"
shots.framing: CU 3/4 from his right front, phone at frame left, sprite top left
shots.focus_plan: on his eyes; the sprite is a soft glow
shots.action: At 48.3 s the sprite pops out above the phone; Ivan's head jerks back 3 cm, eyes up to it, mouth opens (surprise), then a short laugh breath.
shots.screen: phone reply bubble; the glowing yellow Claude sprite above the phone (~[1.00, 3.82, 1.32])
shots.why: The board's surprise beat: the help arrives as a cheerful little character. Claude is friendly before it is anything else.

shots.name: The offer
shots.script: CLAUDE: "I can write a script that sorts your inbox and drafts the replies for you."
shots.framing: over his left shoulder onto the floating card
shots.focus_plan: on the card; his head soft in the right foreground
shots.action: Reading; slow nod; thumb hovers.
shots.screen: card: Claude's reply streams in, with a small sketch of the pipeline (inbox -> sort -> draft -> you)
shots.why: We read the offer with him.

shots.name: yes
shots.script: CLAUDE: "You just review and approve. Want me to build one?"
shots.framing: tight insert on the phone and thumb
shots.action: After the question, the thumb types 'yes' (61.6-62.2 s) and sends.
shots.why: The first yes. A08/A09 already showed where it leads.

shots.name: The plan
shots.script: "That was the plan. Review and approve."
shots.framing: CU sticky note on the back of the laptop lid, Ivan behind
shots.move: creeping push 7 cm, aim tilts up to his face
shots.focus_plan: note -> his face (the focus leaves the promise)
shots.action: Now sitting up at the laptop, typing, pleased; does not look at the note.
shots.props: sticky note REVIEW + APPROVE (port from s02, NOTE moved by OFF)
shots.why: The promise on a sticky note; the focus slipping off it says he won't keep it.

shots.name: Dusk
shots.script: (no line, a breath)
shots.framing: the window glass, city out of focus
shots.focus_plan: on the glass, the city is pure bokeh
shots.action: none
shots.props: city lights switching on (house windows, street lights, red aviation lights)
shots.why: Time passes in one breath; the city becomes bokeh, the seed of the light streaks in B4.

shots.name: It works
shots.script: "But once the email system was working,"
shots.framing: front, floating pipeline cards sharp, Ivan soft behind
shots.action: Ivan watches, typing a little; small satisfied exhale.
shots.screen: floating cards: inbox stack -> gear turning -> drafts stack, an arrow looping back; cards tick green
shots.board: B r2c1 "But once the email system"
shots.why: The system running on its own, drawn the way the board draws it.

shots.name: What else
shots.script: "Ivan saw what else was possible."
shots.framing: ECU both eyes through the glasses, front
shots.action: Eyes slide to his right (73.2 s), hold, then come back to camera and widen (74.3 s); brows lift.
shots.screen: reflection in the lenses: the green pipeline cards
shots.board: B r2c3 + B r2c4 (one shot); B r1c3 folded in
shots.why: An idea, played in the eyes only.

shots.name: Modules
shots.script: "Calendar management. Meeting scheduling. Document drafting. Research summaries."
shots.framing: locked from behind: Ivan's back, desk, monitors
shots.action: Typing; at each icon his head ticks slightly toward it.
shots.screen: icons pop out around the monitors on each word: calendar 75.6, meeting/clock 76.8, document 78.0, research/magnifier 79.2; the monitor tiles light one by one
shots.props: floating icon cards (calendar, clock, docs, folders, gears)
shots.board: B r1c2 (start frame) -> B r3c1 (end frame)
shots.why: Board B's same frame before and after: the empty desk, then the desk surrounded by his new machines.

shots.name: Hours
shots.script: "Each one a few hours of coding."
shots.framing: locked wide from the door corner
shots.action: Ivan at 8x: typing, standing, stretching, sitting; mugs appear on the desk.
shots.why: Days blur in 3.6 s, told by light.

shots.name: Checked off
shots.script: "Each one removing another task from his daily routine."
shots.framing: over the left shoulder on the laptop to-do list
shots.move: tiny push, aim down the list
shots.focus_plan: rack down the list as items tick
shots.action: Hands still; he watches.
shots.screen: TODO.md items check themselves off, then 'nothing left.' (s02 todo())
shots.why: His routine erased line by line.

shots.name: Cheat code
shots.script: "It's like discovering a cheat code for life."
shots.framing: MS front, hands on the keyboard
shots.action: Fingers spread on the keys; mouth opens to a small 'o', then a slow private smile; chin lifts 2 degrees.
shots.why: Wonder, quietly. The board's open-mouthed delight.

shots.name: Hours to minutes
shots.script: "Every problem that used to take hours now takes minutes."
shots.framing: alarm clock large in the left foreground by the lamp, Ivan tiny at the lit desk far right
shots.focus_plan: clock -> Ivan as the hands stop
shots.action: Ivan types far away, small.
shots.props: alarm clock hands overlay: spin 9:12 PM -> 2:58 AM between 94.4 and 96.6 s, then stop
shots.why: Hours collapse into seconds; the lamp and the bed he isn't using sit right beside the clock.

shots.name: Frequency
shots.script: "Ivan feels like he's vibrating at a different frequency"
shots.location: void (stage frame: Ivan at origin facing -y)
shots.framing: wide, Ivan small just left of centre on black
shots.action: Standing, hands loose, looking ahead; breathing. A faint glow pools at his feet.
shots.props: void stage; one warm streak passes low behind him at 100.5 s
shots.why: Hard cut from the room into nothing: the board's small figure on black.

shots.name: Everyone around him
shots.script: "than everyone around him,"
shots.framing: full figure, streaks in front and behind
shots.focus_plan: on Ivan; streaks are big soft blobs
shots.action: Still; the two ghost copies (s02 vibrate) shake around him while every streak drifts slowly.
shots.why: The world drifts slowly; only he is humming fast.

shots.name: The door
shots.script: "like he's stepped through a door that others can't even see."
shots.framing: low, from behind his shoulder, a tunnel of light streaks
shots.action: He takes one step forward (107.5 s), then stands; head tilts up.
shots.props: streak tunnel rushing toward a vanishing point; at 109.0 s the streaks part into a tall slot of white light (the door); bloom to white 110.6-111.6
shots.why: The door only he can see. The peak of the high.

shots.name: Back
shots.script: (no line)
shots.framing: ECU right eye through the lens
shots.action: One slow blink; the eye refocuses.
shots.screen: in the lens: warm streaks slow down and turn back into lines of code
shots.why: Out of the white and back into his eye: the streaks were the screen all along.

shots.name: Barely slept
shots.script: "He's barely slept."
shots.framing: MS through the window from outside, glass reflections over him
shots.focus_plan: on his eyes through the glass
shots.action: Standing at the window, mug in the right hand at chest height, looking out at the city; he doesn't drink.
shots.props: standing Ivan, mug in hand, window exterior face
shots.why: Glass between him and the world, as the board draws it. Fallback camera inside at [1.40, 3.20, 1.50] if the exterior face doesn't hold up.

shots.name: Unanswered
shots.script: "His girlfriend stopped texting... Ironic, given that his system now responds to everyone else." + [phone lights up on the couch]
shots.framing: low on the duvet: phone foreground, the desk and Ivan's back deep in frame
shots.focus_plan: phone -> the monitors as the phone goes dark
shots.action: Ivan at the desk, back to camera, typing; never turns.
shots.screen: phone wakes at 118.0 s: 'Sarah: are you ok?' (buzz), dims at 122.0 s; monitor: auto-replies fire 'Sent v' x12
shots.props: phone on the bed, notification glow on the duvet
shots.board: C r1c2 "gf stopped texting" + C r1c3 "system responds to everyone" (one shot)
shots.why: One focus pull says the irony: her message in the foreground, his machine answering everyone else behind.

shots.name: Thinness
shots.script: "He knows this isn't healthy. He can feel something fraying..., a thinness to his thoughts."
shots.framing: CU from the desk end, past his face to the window bokeh
shots.move: very slow push 15 cm over 10.6 s
shots.action: Mug at his lips, sips, holds it there; eyes heavy, half-lidded; at 130 s his gaze drifts off the screen to nothing.
shots.props: mug in hand; from 129.4 s the city bokeh behind him stretches into thin horizontal lines
shots.board: C r1c4 "he knows it's not healthy" + C r2c1 "thinness to his thoughts" (one shot)
shots.why: Held a beat longer than comfortable; the world behind him thins out while he stays still.

shots.name: Close to something
shots.script: "But he's close to something."
shots.framing: OTS close, his profile left, screen bokeh right
shots.focus_plan: on his lips and the mug
shots.action: Drains the last of the coffee in one tilt, puts the mug down hard, leans in.
shots.board: C r2c2 "one more mode... then he'll rest"
shots.why: Decision in one gesture: finish the cup, lean in.

shots.name: One more
shots.script: "One more module. One more integration."
shots.framing: insert on the second monitor
shots.action: (off-screen) typing
shots.screen: Monitor2 (live): new tab modules/briefing.py opens (140.6 s), then integrations/slack.py (141.9 s); 'Proceed? (y/n) y'
shots.why: 'One more' made literal: two new files in three seconds.

shots.name: Then he'll rest
shots.script: "Then he'll rest."
shots.framing: the empty bed in lamplight, from its foot
shots.action: none (typing heard off-screen)
shots.why: The rest he promises, empty and waiting. Hold past the line.

shots.name: Not all pleasant
shots.script: "It's not all pleasant."
shots.framing: high angle: the desk alone in a pool of light, the room black
shots.action: Typing, hunched lower than at 3 AM.
shots.why: The board's isolation frame (and the dark vignette of 'Who are you?'): nothing exists but the desk.

shots.name: Eyes burn
shots.script: "Around 4 AM, when his eyes burn"
shots.framing: low CU from the laptop, face lit from below
shots.action: Screws his eyes shut hard (151.6 s), opens them wide, two fast blinks; no hands to the face.
shots.why: The laptop's view of him: what the machine sees.

shots.name: Hands shake
shots.script: "and his hands shake from a caffeine overload,"
shots.framing: top-down over the laptop: left hand typing, right hand lifting the mug
shots.focus_plan: on the keys; the mug shakes into blur
shots.action: Left hand keeps typing; right hand lifts the mug (155.0 s) and it trembles (8-10 Hz, 3-5 mm), coffee ripples, a drop spills.
shots.props: mug in hand, coffee surface ripple, spill drop
shots.why: The body failing in one small physical detail.

shots.name: Creeping dread
shots.script: "Ivan feels a creeping dread."
shots.framing: wide from the dark bed side, Ivan small and lit
shots.action: Stops typing (159.0 s); shoulders rise; he doesn't turn.
shots.why: A01/A03's push again, now from the dark like something approaching him. The camera is the dread.

shots.name: Doesn't understand
shots.script: "A sense that he's building something he doesn't fully understand."
shots.framing: ECU eyes from just above, code streaming in the lenses
shots.focus_plan: on the eyes; the reflection soft
shots.action: Eyes flick left-right trying to read, fall behind, slow down, stop.
shots.screen: lens reflection: code scrolling too fast to read
shots.why: The board's reference frame: code in his glasses, faster than he can read.

shots.name: Takes and gives
shots.script: "That each automation takes something from him, even as it gives something back."
shots.framing: behind his left shoulder: his face soft left, dashboard sharp right
shots.action: Still; the screen light on his face drops a stop over the shot (live key x0.5); his shoulders sink.
shots.why: Gain on the screen, loss on his face, linked by one focus pull.

shots.name: Enter
shots.script: "But then he finishes another module,"
shots.framing: macro from above the keys: one finger coming down on Enter
shots.action: Right middle finger raised, held, comes down hard on Enter at 175.8 s.
shots.why: Cut on the key hit.

shots.name: It works
shots.script: "and it works,"
shots.framing: over the left shoulder on the terminal
shots.action: (still)
shots.screen: terminal: tests run, '42 passed' in green at 177.0 s; the green floods the screen
shots.why: The hit, on screen.

shots.name: Rush
shots.script: "and the dread dissolves into a rush of pure satisfaction."
shots.framing: CU face, reverse dolly zoom
shots.move: reverse dolly zoom: camera pushes in as the lens widens; the room opens out behind him
shots.action: Exhale through the nose, shoulders drop, a grin spreads; eyes shine.
shots.screen: green light on his face, turning warmer
shots.why: A05's dolly zoom reversed: then the room crowded in, now it releases him.

shots.name: HE built that
shots.script: "HE... built that. The machine does what HE told it to do."
shots.framing: low angle from the desk top, the full glass soft in the foreground
shots.focus_plan: on his eyes; the glass soft
shots.action: Sits up straight, chin lifts, a slow proud nod on each 'HE' (183.8 s, 186.8 s).
shots.why: The hero angle, with the untouched glass still in the frame.

shots.name: Dawn
shots.script: [Dawn at the window.] (no line)
shots.framing: wide on the window from inside
shots.action: none in frame
shots.props: city lights go out in waves; sky warms; sun breaks behind the towers
shots.why: A wordless breath; the night ends by itself.

shots.name: By sunrise
shots.script: "By sunrise, Ivan has a system"
shots.framing: locked from behind (C03's frame), now sunlit
shots.action: Typing slows; stops.
shots.props: window-frame shadows across the floor and his back; mugs x4
shots.why: The same frame as the montage, with the work done.

shots.name: Four tiles
shots.script: "that handles his email, manages his calendar, drafts his documents, and summarizes his reading."
shots.framing: insert on the dashboard monitor
shots.action: (none)
shots.screen: dashboard tiles tick green on each word: email 199.2, calendar 200.5, documents 202.0, reading 203.8; 'all systems running'
shots.props: sun glare sliding across the screen
shots.why: The list on screen, ticked off on the words.

shots.name: Leans back
shots.script: "He leans back in his chair, exhausted and wired."
shots.location: room (desk chair, turned to the window)
shots.framing: MS from the window side: sun on his front, blue screens behind him
shots.action: Pushes back from the desk, swivels the chair ~130 degrees to face the window, leans back, hands behind his head (intro S5 acting), eyes half shut in the sun.
shots.props: chair swivel + recline; mullion shadow cross on his chest
shots.why: The board's last panel: warm sun on him, the cold screens at his back.

shots.name: Now what
shots.script: "Then he realizes... he doesn't know what he's supposed to do now."
shots.framing: CU face in the sun
shots.action: Eyes open (211.0 s); the half-smile fades; he looks to the window, then down, then at nothing; hands come down from his head slowly (215 s).
shots.why: The realization plays on his face in silence after the line.

shots.name: Still full
shots.script: (no line)
shots.framing: desk height, the full glass foreground, Ivan beyond facing the window
shots.action: Sits still, facing the window.
shots.props: the full glass in the sun, a caustic on the desk (motif, frame 3 of 3)
shots.why: The motif returns changed: the same full glass, now gold.

shots.name: Sunrise room
shots.script: (no line; end)
shots.framing: top-down wide, A01's frame
shots.action: Ivan small in the chair turned to the window, not moving.
shots.props: window pattern of sun across the bed (plan_topdown look); fade to black 229.8-231.8
shots.why: Bookend: the room from above again, full of light now, and he has nowhere to go.
